name: FastGS Residual Pyramid Rendering
definition: A multi-scale rendering technique that decomposes the target image into a Laplacian pyramid of Gaussian splats. The coarsest level renders the base image, while subsequent levels render signed residuals (differences) that are upsampled and accumulated to reconstruct the final high-resolution image.
summary: FastGS Residual Pyramid Rendering decomposes images into a Laplacian pyramid of Gaussian splats, enabling independent multi-scale optimization for efficient training and high-fidelity reconstruction.
